title: Operator decision: native Scheduler production authority under existing Jarvis trust

conditions.description: Choose source-only design authority, NOT live activation. Existing W12 signed native roster contract requires host-owned account→authenticated subject mapping, trusted ECDSA SPKI and complete approval bound to account/ledger/epoch, version/head and operation. W12 checkpoint12886 and challenge446160db... found no production mapping/key provisioning/signer in d9bea119/e41f16c; Auth.fs63–73 and McpTools.fs74–88 are authenticated audit identity, not roster approval; local preview binding/WQ06/manual grants and generic Challenge reply are not original-bound outcome authority. W16 90dff82 Accepted12897, production denied. Under already-approved existing OAuth/Git trusted workflow and no new signing service, APPROVE A: develop a bounded default-off typed server-verified authenticated human approval record in existing canonical account/project Git ledgers, explicit operator-confirmed account↔subject mapping and full roster/epoch/version/head/request binding, as an alternative production authority to ECDSA fixture proof (preserve disposable signed APIs and existing verification, no fake signature); exact original reservation/account/project operation/digest/generation plus independently verified terminal/no-send source and attributable human approval for manual reconciliation; no automatic provider terminal when no actual issuer, no unknown release, no trust expansion or live seed. Independent source design/review and exact negative tests required before any use. OR B: retain ECDSA-only production requirement and provide exact existing approved account binding, trusted SPKI and genuinely approved signing path/provenance; if unavailable, Scheduler production reserve/release stays HOLD. Decline/alternative allowed. No production credential, live send, actual reservation, release, deployment, restart or activation authorized by this design decision.
